edits.after: Late you reclaim it: the W-stun locks him the instant Fate Sealed blinks in, and Aegis blocks the Soul Unbound snap-back burst cold.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. It governs your forward steps. - E Aegis Assault spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: Open Aegis into his Q3-R chain — the frontal block eats the knock-up burst and the snap-back damage.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Shoved waves are R tickets — a Yone farming freely to crit items while you idle mid is a loss you chose; go tax the map.

At full build his Fate Sealed drops to an 80-second cooldown and every second attack crits with bonus magic damage, so he flanks fights you thought were settled. Save your W stun for the instant he blinks in — it locks him inside your team — and Aegis-block the Soul Unbound snap-back, his one commitment he cannot cancel.
